kandidaten.notiz: Project Nimbus (2015) achieved the inaugural projection of moving images onto clouds from aircraft. The image (Horse in Motion – Muybridge 1878) is a shared cultural reference between art & science. Beyond the spectacle, genuine collaboration was underpinned by art as research, involving aviators, technologists, and cultural specialists, driven by the power of idea and…

kandidaten.titel: FANGØ a Facebook, Amazon, Netflix and Google Obfuscator
kandidaten.notiz: FANGØ is a defense weapon against surveillance capitalism. Disguised as a mobile phone charger, it operates as a microcontroller that takes control of the smartphone in which it is plugged into. Making random searches and liking random posts on popular social platforms, it aims to deceive data brokers and disrupt the data capturing process.

A big number of audiences online nowadays is mainly algorithms. Algorithms are trained on the auditory information that is produced and uploaded by humans. In Not allowed for algorithmic audiences, a digital assistant situated in an Athenian apartment exhibits an odd behavior.

The project TRACEWASTE observes and visualizes garbage movements from a citizen’s perspective to explore future urban life in the context of waste management. It tracks discarded objects using geolocation methods, providing insights into waste whereabouts, transport durations, distances, and emissions. IoT devices (0G) in a low power wide area network track various types of waste…

kandidaten.urheber: Ory Lab Inc., OYAMATSU Design Studio, TASUKI Inc.
kandidaten.notiz: Besides developing OriHime and OriHime-D, which users regardless of age, gender, or disability can remotely operate, Ory Lab has created the Dawn Avatar Robot Café, where users work and visit via robots. Users can seek employment via the company’s Avatar Guild staffing agency, thus remaining active in society.

kandidaten.titel: The Glass Room: Misinformation Community Edition
kandidaten.notiz: The Glass Room: Misinformation Community Edition is an interactive community engagement exhibition that invites people to think critically and proactively about their relationship with digital technologies. It is a space to reflect, discuss, and debate how technology impacts our daily lives and how we consume information, focusing on misinformation, political influence, and democracy.

Bio-art: When a Tree became a Partner Grand Prize – Innovative Collaboration: Awarded for innovative collaboration between industry or technology and the arts that opens new pathways for innovation. It was the rebirth of the Biscarosse Elm in the frame of Olga Kisseleva’s Biopresence project (2012) that served as a catalyst for the creation of…

kandidaten.titel: Design by Decay, Decay by Design
kandidaten.notiz: Grand Prize – Artistic Exploration: Awarded for artistic exploration and art works where appropriation by the arts has a strong potential to influence or alter the use, deployment or perception of technology. Design by Decay, Decay by Design is a series of artifacts that exhibit designed decay. They were done for the 2019 Ginkgo Bioworks…
Perception iO (Input Output) is the future of Law Enforcement. An Artificial Intelligence data set emotionally responsive to the participant and potentially their bias.

kandidaten.titel: Proposals of Collaboration with the Viral Entities / Tame is to Tame, Virophilia
kandidaten.notiz: Proposals of Collaboration with the Viral Entities is a series of endeavours towards finding a balance between our anthropocentric position and our unavoidable encounter of the viral others.

In Sociality, Cirio collected and rated Internet inventions submitted to the U.S. patent office. Subsequently, he invited the public to share, flag, and ban the technologies designed to monitor and manipulate social behaviors.
SOMEONE is a meditation on the smart home, the tensions between intimacy vs privacy, convenience vs agency, and the role of human labor in the future of automation.

Through three perceptual machines, TransVision questions the habitual ways in which we interpret and understand the visual world intervened by digital media, and how technology mediates the way we perceive reality.

aqua_forensic illuminates the invisible anthropogenic pharmaceutical pollutants—residues of human consumption. The project combines art/science/citizen science in a “hunt for a monster” and opens the discussion about our solidarity and empathy with waters beyond human perception.

kandidaten.titel: CMD: Experiment in Bio Algorithmic Politics
kandidaten.notiz: In this installation, two artificial ecosystems are sharing a light source. The photosynthetic cells and the computer are experimenting with different political systems granting access to this resource, allowing the system to oscillate between collaboration and competition.

kandidaten.urheber: Pierre Azalbert, Benton Ching, Karlijn Sibbel
kandidaten.notiz: Re:flex is the result of experiment-driven, multidisciplinary research around materials that can respond to physical stimuli. It draws inspiration from natural organisms which can adapt to changes in their environment by adjusting themselves naturally to new circumstances.
Sounding Soil began when Marcus Maeder one day, out of sheer curiosity, stuck a self-developed, highly sensitive needle microphone into the ground on an alpine pasture in the Valais/Switzerland.

kandidaten.titel: The Net Wanderer – A tour of suspended handshakes
kandidaten.notiz: The Net Wanderer is a research project that explores the connection between the critical network gateways in China and the infrastructure running these gateways.

Topographie Digitale is an interactive installation. This landscape uses electrically functionalized and pleated textiles as sensitive surfaces reacting to touch to interact with a video-projected digital clone of this scenery.

On the Eastern boundary of Europe, razor-wire fence stretches across Georgia. It marks territories occupied by the Russian invasion of 2008. Voicing Borders is an installation addressing this situation.

kandidaten.urheber: Territorial Agency – John Palmesino and Ann-Sofi Rönnskog
kandidaten.notiz: Grand Prize – Artistic Exploration: Awarded for artistic exploration and art works where appropriation by the arts has a strong potential to influence or alter the use, deployment or perception of technology. Oceans in Transformation investigates the impact of human activity on the world ocean. The global ocean is changing its circulations, energies, interactions, and…
Data Garden is an organism-based data centre. This functional carbon negative data infrastructure is capable of storing and retrieving data from the DNA of plants.

Ania Catherine and Dejha Ti’s seminal interactive performance installation On View (2019), commissioned by the SCAD Museum of Art, examines the generational desire to be the subject of an art experience and that phenomenon’s relationship to addictive interfaces, surveillance capitalism, and data privacy in modern society.

kandidaten.urheber: Yuning Chan, Tom Hartley, Yishan Qin
kandidaten.notiz: We designed a living wearable that enables people to become the hosts for endangered organisms, which in return gives them a sense of companionship and belonging, advocating a new concept of participatory conservation.

kandidaten.urheber: Fraunhofer MEVIS, Marshmallow Laser Feast, Natan Sinigaglia
kandidaten.notiz: A cross-sectoral project centered on utilizing high-end MR research results, The Tides Within Us is an ongoing exploration into the world beyond the limits of our senses at the intersection of art, science, and technology.
Constructing Connectivity is a person-centered stroke rehabilitation method that addresses the need to quicken and improve recovery, motivate the patient, and provide connection to support systems.

The Genetics Gym is an ongoing research project, depicting a calculated fiction of modified bodies, edited with hypothetical new and emerging genetic technologies, allowing in-depth exploration to question how the internet is affecting human behavior.
MycoMythologies is a series researching how fungal ontologies could help humans think, learn, and practice multispecies survival through practices of inclusion and caring.

Plant Neurobiologist Stefano Mancuso and artist Thijs Biersteker created an artwork that uncovers the invisible tree-to-tree communication in real time to start a conversation about the effects of climate change.

kandidaten.urheber: Felix Lenz, Angela Neubauer, Eszter Zwickl
kandidaten.notiz: Dismantling the deceptively pristine image of the high-tech industry The Cleanroom Paradox unveils the systemic suppression of information on occupational and toxic hazards at semiconductor production sites.

kandidaten.titel: The Planetary Compendium: Case Studies on Planetary Governance
kandidaten.notiz: The jury sees in it a scalable educational tool that can engage students in investigating systemic changes in finance, culture, technology, and policy (…)

kandidaten.titel: c o m p u t e r 1. 0
kandidaten.urheber: Julian Goldman, Victoria Manganiello, SOFT MONITOR
kandidaten.notiz: Full or empty; color or clear; zero or one; under or over – c o m p u t e r 1.0 imagines a display for the future, by looking at displays from our past.
Glaciers are sentinels of climate change. This series of works embodies the stunning beauty, rapid change, fragility, and magnificence of glaciers.

kandidaten.titel: Shapes and Ladders: Battles of Bias and Bureaucracy
kandidaten.urheber: John Ahloy, Andrea Li, Michelle Lim, Anne Liu
kandidaten.notiz: Shapes and Ladders is a video game that shows how systemic racism and sexism can exist through the metaphor of climbing a career ladder.
Stymphalian Birds is an art installation in which complex haptic interactions with feathers are sonified in acoustic soundscapes.

kandidaten.titel: Margi – India’s one stop against online harms
kandidaten.notiz: *Margi* helps citizens to find local or national resources and solutions in their language of preference with just a few clicks.
Lovewear is smart underwear that helps people of all abilities to self-explore and enhance their own intimacy and sexuality.
Prosthetic Memory is an ongoing experiment in self-augmentation combining handmade journals, daily videos, and a custom AI.
Theirtube is an open-source web service that provides a look into how videos are recommended on other people’s YouTube.
Compression Cradle envisages a future world where mechanical touch is an antidote for today’s ‘forever connectedness.’
The Code of Conscience is open source software that restricts the use of heavy-duty vehicles in protected land areas.
The Substitute explores a paradox: our preoccupation with creating new life forms, while neglecting existing ones.
In Event of Moon Disaster illustrates the possibilities of deepfake technologies by reimagining the moon landing.
The Para-optic 8 project offers a visual experience that literally reproduces the idea of vision through fingers.
INNER VALUES deals with the value of alleged waste products in animal processing.
